results.title: iOS Build Number not defined
results.description: expo.ios.buildNumber must be incremented with each App Store submission.
results.fix: Add 'buildNumber' under expo.ios in app.json. E.g.: '1'

results.title: Android Version Code not defined
results.description: expo.android.versionCode must be an integer incremented with each Google Play submission.
results.fix: Add 'versionCode' under expo.android in app.json. E.g.: 1

results.title: iOS Privacy Manifest not configured
results.description: Apple requires PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy since May 2024. In Expo, configure via expo.ios.privacyManifests in app.json.
results.fix: Add 'privacyManifests' under expo.ios with NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes and the APIs used by the app.

results.title: Privacy Policy URL not found
results.description: Apple and Google require a Privacy Policy. The URL must be configured in app.json and provided in the stores.
results.fix: Add 'privacyPolicyUrl' in app.json with the URL of your privacy policy.

results.title: supportsTablet not explicitly defined
results.description: Explicitly define whether the app supports iPad to avoid ambiguity during review.
results.fix: Add 'supportsTablet: true' or 'false' under expo.ios in app.json.
